name: Youth Volunteer Program: Summer of Service
city: Roanoke, Christiansburg, Rocky Mount and Lexington, VA
what_you_do: Help at a Carilion hospital for 6 to 8 weeks in summer. You work with staff and adult helpers, learn about health jobs, and make friends.
deadline_text: For 2026, Carilion held a virtual information session on Tuesday, February 24, 2026 and posted a 2026 application. 2027 dates are not posted; expect a late winter start.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Summer of Service form on the volunteer page when it is posted. If you missed the info session, email the volunteer boss at your hospital.
notes: It runs at four hospitals: Roanoke, Rocky Mount, Christiansburg and Lexington. Each one has its own volunteer boss. Their emails are on the Volunteer Services page under Summer of Service.
